digest.component_or_area: enrich gate marker and write-path drain
propositions: A single pending entry in the queue disables the O(1) fast-path gate marker store-wide, forcing a full directory walk on every write until the pending set empties
On a 4,938-ticket store with one pending entry, writes cost ~1.2 seconds (full store walk) versus ~0.11 ms when the marker engages (quiet store), a 4,800x regression
The marker write logic is all-or-nothing: it only writes on a full scan that found zero pending entries, leaving no marker when any entry is pending
The solution generalizes the marker to record a live set (ticket ids with enqueued, not-DONE entries) and scopes subsequent probes to O(backlog) reductions instead of O(store) walks
Scoped probes never rewrite the marker, preserving the TTL as measured from the last full walk and preventing marker-refresh races
The marker still asserts only absence of pending work; every queue append clears it; wrong-typed live field invalidates the entire marker
